channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro fura bolha da Copa e lidera debate político nas redes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro was sentenced to four years and two months in prison by the STF for coercion in attempting to interfere with his father Jair Bolsonaro's conviction. The unanimous ruling triggered a 242.7% surge in social media mentions over two days, making him the 9th most searched term on Google Trends Brazil and breaking through the World Cup discourse in Trending Topics.

item.title: Indecisos abrem caminho para derrotar Lula no 2º turno, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado states that the growing number of undecided voters will be decisive in defeating Lula in a potential runoff, as former Flávio Bolsonaro supporters have shifted to the independent bloc, creating space for a third-way candidate. He argues the opposition must present a candidate with superior governance experience and profile to win over these undecided voters and prevent Lula from gaining strength heading into the second round. Caiado denies his remarks constitute criticism of Bolsonaro, insisting they are based solely on polling data.

item.title: Lula diz que não tem nenhuma queixa contra a China
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated at the G7 summit in France that he has no complaints against China, noting that the Asian country filled commercial and investment spaces left vacant by the United States and the European Union. He emphasized that Brazil’s trade surplus with China stands at $165 billion and urged wealthy nations to increase investments in poorer regions to stimulate global economic growth.

item.title: Mendonça vota pela cassação de deputados do Podemos no Amapá acusados de usar candidatas laranjas
item.description: Minister André Mendonça, rapporteur of the case at the TSE, voted for the annulment of Podemos state deputies in Amapá due to gender quota fraud, acknowledging the party used three dummy female candidates in the 2022 elections. The trial was suspended by a view request from Minister Dias Toffoli and will resume on April 23.

item.title: Após G7, Lula reage a comentários de Trump sobre Bolsonaro e eleições: 'não se meta no Brasil'
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva responded to Donald Trump's comments regarding the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro, stating that the U.S. should not interfere in Brazil's internal affairs. Lula emphasized national sovereignty and rejected any foreign meddling in Brazilian elections.

item.title: Lula diz não ter conversado com Trump no G7 sobre tarifas
item.description: President Lula stated he did not discuss tariffs with Trump during the G7 summit in France, despite attending after the U.S. announced potential extra tariffs on Brazilian goods. He said he did not request a bilateral meeting because trade negotiations are ongoing through officials, and called the tariff plan 'outrageous'. Lula also criticized the U.S. designation of CV and PCC as terrorist groups, arguing they are financially motivated, not seeking to replace the state.

item.title: “Ele age como um camaleão”, diz Marinho após fala de Lula sobre não ser esquerdista
item.description: Senator Rogério Marinho (PL-RN), leader of the opposition in the Senate, criticized President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, saying he 'acts like a chameleon,' changing his speech according to convenience. Marinho reacted to Lula’s remarks in which the president claimed not to fit traditional left-wing labels, calling such statements incoherent and opportunistic.

item.title: Lula diz que Trump 'conhece pouco o Brasil' e cobra para que ele não se meta nas eleições
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva said Donald Trump knows little about Brazil and suggested the U.S. could learn from Brazil how to hold more peaceful, lighter, and less turbulent elections. Lula firmly urged Trump not to interfere in Brazil’s elections and to respect national sovereignty.

item.title: 'Ouvi dizer que prenderam o Bolsonaro Jr.': Trump confunde filhos do ex-presidente citando condenação de Eduardo
item.description: At the G7 in France, Donald Trump confused Jair Bolsonaro's sons, claiming he heard 'they arrested Bolsonaro Jr.', when he was actually referring to the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro, former federal deputy, by the STF for coercing judges and pursuing international sanctions against Brazil's judiciary. Trump also called Brazil a 'politically difficult country' after speaking with Lula, mentioning tariffs and designating criminal groups as terrorists. The Bolsonaro family's pre-candidate for the 2026 presidency is Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, not Eduardo.

item.title: Presidente do TSE inaugura Sala dos Partidos Políticos Senador Petrônio Portella
item.description: TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques inaugurated the Political Parties Room Senator Petrônio Portella at the TSE headquarters in Brasília, in a ceremony attended by party leaders and the honoree's family. The space aims to provide technical support and infrastructure to political parties within the Court, as part of the program for signing the Term of Commitment for Electoral Integrity 2026. Petrônio Portella, a senator and key political leader during Brazil's political opening, was honored for his role in promoting dialogue and consensus-building in Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Nenhuma mudança no front do STF sobre as eleições no Rio
item.description: Three STF justices state there is insufficient time to hold a new election in Rio de Janeiro for a temporary mandate. The Court will maintain the status quo, with no changes to the electoral situation. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: Crusoé: Trump ouviu dizer que “Bolsonaro Jr.” foi preso
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump said he had heard that Eduardo Bolsonaro, known as 'Bolsonaro Jr.', had been arrested. He made the remark during a press briefing at the G7 summit in France, in response to questions about Eduardo Bolsonaro's conviction by the First Chamber of Brazil's Supreme Federal Court. The story was first published by O Antagonista.

item.title: No G-7, Trump diz que Brasil está perigoso politicamente e Lula pede que ele não se meta na eleição
item.description: At the G-7 summit in Évian-les-Bains, Donald Trump claimed Brazil is 'politically dangerous' regarding its elections, referencing the arrest of a candidate and confusing Eduardo Bolsonaro with Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula responded that Trump knows little about Brazil, defended national sovereignty, and urged him not to interfere in Brazilian elections, praising the country's electronic voting system as a model of stability.

item.title: O palpite de Trump sobre a política do Brasil
item.description: Donald Trump said Brazil's political situation is 'a little dangerous' after meeting with Lula in France, mentioning the alleged arrest of Eduardo Bolsonaro and criticizing Brazil's political climate. He also reiterated his unfounded claims about U.S. election fraud, stating that American elections are 'totally rigged'.

item.title: STF define que redes não serão punidas se provarem 'dúvida razoável' sobre ilicitude de publicações
item.description: The STF ruled that social media platforms will not be punished for failing to remove allegedly illicit content if they can demonstrate a 'reasonable doubt' about its illegality through a 'qualified diligence analysis'. The decision sets a standard of proof to avoid objective liability for companies in content moderation.

item.title: 56% votariam em candidato a favor do fim da taxa das blusinhas, mostra pesquisa
item.description: A Proteste survey conducted in May 2026 shows that 56% of voters would support a candidate advocating for the end of the 'blusinhas tax,' rising to 63% in the Southeast and 57% in the South. The issue gained momentum after the federal government issued a Provisional Measure abolishing the 20% import tax on international shipments under US$50, which must be approved by Congress by September 8 — one month before the elections. 92% of consumers believe ending the tax is correct, and 75% consider the current charge unfair.

item.title: Pacheco critica ataques eleitorais ao STF: “Populista e muito pobre”
item.description: Senator Rodrigo Pacheco (PSB-MG) criticized the use of attacks on the Supreme Federal Tribunal as an electoral strategy, calling the discourse opportunistic, populist, and very poor. He emphasized the STF's crucial role during the pandemic and after the January 8 attacks, arguing that while technical criticism is part of democratic debate, unfounded aggression against the Court is not.

item.title: Bolsonaro tinha arma em casa e equipe de segurança a deixou inoperante, diz defesa
item.description: The defense of former President Jair Bolsonaro admitted to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes that Bolsonaro possessed a pistol at home during house arrest. According to his lawyers, the security team rendered the weapon inoperable without Bolsonaro's prior knowledge. The statement was made on Wednesday, the 17th, following Moraes' request for clarification on Tuesday, the 16th.

item.title: Pacheco nega relatar 6x1 e diz que Alcolumbre pediu PEC da Segurança
item.description: Rodrigo Pacheco denied he will be the rapporteur of the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, stating he did not request the role. He said Davi Alcolumbre only considered his possible contribution to the Public Security PEC, without any decision. The Security PEC is a Planalto priority for the 2026 elections but remains stalled due to tensions between Alcolumbre and the Lula government.

item.title: TCE vê "orçamento paralelo" com incentivos fiscais da gestão Tarcísio
item.description: The São Paulo State Court of Accounts (TCE-SP) identified that fiscal incentives under Governor Tarcísio de Freitas created a 'parallel budget', with tax renunciations growing faster than revenue and concentrating 80% of benefits in just 1% of companies. The report highlights weak oversight, lack of impact studies, and poor traceability, including companies receiving benefits while being listed as active debtors.

item.title: “Considero uma boa dupla”, diz Zanatta sobre ser vice de Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy Júlia Zanatta (PL-SC) said she is ready to run as vice president on a ticket with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), if that is the decision of the political group led by Jair Bolsonaro. She made the comment during a lunch meeting of the Parliamentary Front for the Free Market, stating she considers the duo a strong option. Zanatta is being mentioned as a possible running mate in the PL’s 2026 presidential ticket.

item.title: Cotada para vice de Flávio também defende rompimento total de PL com Zema
item.description: Deputy Júlia Zanatta, backed by Eduardo Bolsonaro as a potential running mate for Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, calls for a definitive break between the PL and Romeu Zema, the Novo party’s presidential pre-candidate. She criticized Zema’s attacks on Flávio Bolsonaro, particularly after the revelation of his ties to Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master, and argued that the Novo stands to lose more than the PL by leveraging Bolsonaro’s base.

item.title: Um dia após condenação no STF, Eduardo pede a Trump que 'reimponha' sanções contra Moraes
item.description: One day after being unanimously convicted by Brazil's Supreme Federal Court (STF) for coercing magistrates and attempting to secure foreign sanctions against the Brazilian judiciary, former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro urged Donald Trump to 'reimpose' sanctions against Minister Alexandre de Moraes, calling him a dictator and human rights violator. Eduardo was sentenced to four years and two months in semi-open prison, fined 100 minimum wages, declared immediately ineligible for eight years, and stripped of his position as a Federal Police clerk. He rejects the conviction, claiming he was not properly notified via official channels and asserting his address is public knowledge.

item.title: “Ele pode continuar gostando do Bolsonaro, do pai, do filho, do neto”, diz Lula sobre Trump
item.description: President Lula said he has no issue if Donald Trump continues to like the Bolsonaro family, referring to former President Jair Bolsonaro, his son, and grandson. The remark came after a private meeting between the two leaders on the sidelines of the G7 summit, where Lula downplayed any diplomatic tension stemming from Trump’s affinities toward the Bolsonaros.

item.title: Lula diz que nunca foi esquerdista em áudio vazado no G7
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated in a leaked audio from a G7 event that he has never been a leftist, in an apparent effort to reshape his image before international allies. The remark comes amid growing domestic and external scrutiny over his political ideology ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: O que Trump fez foi coisa desaforada, diz Lula sobre novo tarifaço
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva called Donald Trump's proposal for new tariffs on Brazil 'outrageous,' saying Trump acts like an 'emperor.' Lula emphasized that Brazil prefers to resolve trade differences through ongoing negotiations and is ready to engage directly if talks fail.

item.title: Trump diz que Brasil é 'politicamente perigoso' e que 'querem prender Bolsonaro Jr.'
item.description: US President Donald Trump stated at a G7 press briefing that Brazil is 'politically dangerous' and claimed that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a leading presidential candidate and Lula’s main rival in 2026 polls, had been or would be arrested over a statement made in Texas. Trump confused the names of Jair Bolsonaro’s sons but emphasized Flávio’s electoral standing, accusing Brazil’s elections of being 'totally frauded' and 'manipulated'.

item.title: Lula reclama com assessor durante o G7: “Fico puto”
item.description: President Lula expressed irritation upon arriving late to the G7 meeting in France on June 17, 2026, complaining to his aide that he was 'pissed off' about the situation. He disputed an aide's claim that other leaders were already present, stating he found only one person in the room. The exchange was captured on an open microphone before he was informed the press was filming.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula fala a jornalistas após participar da Cúpula do G7
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will speak to journalists after attending the G7 Summit in Évian-les-Bains, France, marking his 10th appearance as a guest. Although Brazil is not a member of the G7 and does not participate in final negotiations, its delegation may endorse texts of interest after approval by member states. Lula also met with von der Leyen and Costa, while Trump passed by him without greeting.

item.title: Governo calcula impacto de R$ 22,4 bilhões com renegociação de dívidas agrícolas em 2027; meta de contas no azul ficaria mais difícil
item.description: The federal government estimates that the agricultural debt renegotiation, approved by the Senate, will have a fiscal impact of R$ 22.4 billion in 2027, making it harder to achieve the primary surplus target of 0.5% of GDP (R$ 73.2 billion) set in the Budget Guidelines Law. The measure, which will benefit producers affected by extreme weather and geopolitical conflicts, involves a new credit line of R$ 200 billion and could raise the total cost to the Union to R$ 139.8 billion over 13 years. Without full exclusion of court-ordered payments (precatory debts), the government projects only R$ 8 billion in primary surplus for 2027, far below the desired target.

item.title: O que disse Trump ao encontrar Lula no G7
item.description: Lula and Trump had a brief encounter at the G7 in France after missing each other in the official photo. In leaked audio, Lula said he 'cannot tolerate the behavior' of the U.S. government, criticizing protectionism and the unilateral designation of Brazilian criminal groups as terrorists. The meeting aimed to address threats of new 25% tariffs on Brazilian goods, but no formal bilateral talk took place.

item.title: Economistas avaliam discurso de Lula e recado a Trump
item.description: Lula used his G7 speech to call for greater multilateralism and criticize U.S. protectionism, particularly the tariffs announced by the White House, while Trump passed by him without greeting during the 'family photo'. Economists, such as Sérgio Vale of MB Associados, noted that Lula's speech inappropriately mixed topics like neoliberalism and fiscal responsibility, arguing that fiscal discipline is necessary to sustain social policies, not opposed to them. The incident was interpreted as a sign of growing tension in Brazil-U.S. trade relations.

item.title: Tarcísio vê condenação de Eduardo "injusta" e sem efeito sobre chapa
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas called Eduardo Bolsonaro's STF conviction for obstructing justice in the coup plot unjust, stating it will not affect his group's electoral ticket. Eduardo was sentenced to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime and 8 years of ineligibility, with appeal possible. Experts note the penalty may require candidate substitution up to 20 days before the first round, as Electoral Justice treats the ticket as a unit.

item.title: “Nunca fui esquerdista”, diz Lula a presidente do FMI
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva told IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva in an informal conversation that he 'was never a leftist', countering expectations that his first administration would pursue left-wing policies. Lula emphasized that, despite predictions, his government followed a moderate path focused on economic stability. The remark came as Georgieva noted the positive surprise of Lula’s first term in office.

item.title: Visita ao Poder: Daniella Marques
item.description: Daniella Marques, former president of Caixa Econômica Federal and administrator, visited the Poder360 headquarters in Brasília on Wednesday, June 17, 2026. She is part of the economic core of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign, the PL’s pre-candidate for the Presidency of the Republic.

item.title: Flávio caiu nas pesquisas e finge defender Bolsa Família, diz PT
item.description: The PT released a video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's pre-candidate for president, claiming he is declining in polls and falsely defending the Bolsa Família program, despite his father Jair Bolsonaro's history of opposing it. Flávio had previously supported the program as an acquired right and proposed extending its benefits after beneficiaries enter formal employment.

item.title: Tarcísio ‘joga parado’ ao ver Eduardo condenado pelo STF e deve conter apoio a André do Prado
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas will adopt a 'standing still' stance in André do Prado's Senate campaign, avoiding explicit support due to Eduardo Bolsonaro's STF conviction for attempting to interfere in the coup plot case, which could provoke adversarial attacks linking the ticket to international sanctions and harm his relationship with the Supreme Court. Eduardo Bolsonaro, sentenced to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime, remains as substitute on Do Prado's ticket and insists on staying in the race despite being abroad.

item.title: Leia a íntegra do discurso de Lula no G7 sobre regulamentação das redes
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva spoke at the G7 on artificial intelligence and protection of minors online, criticizing the concentration of power by big techs and noting their valuations rival major economies while 2.6 billion people remain offline. He praised the Digital ECA as one of the world’s most advanced laws for protecting children and adolescents in digital spaces.

item.title: TSE e partidos políticos firmam acordo pela integridade das Eleições 2026
item.description: The TSE and 26 of the 30 registered political parties in Brazil signed a commitment term to ensure the integrity of the 2026 Elections, focusing on combating disinformation, responsible AI use, citizen participation, and electoral trust. The agreement does not create new legal obligations or sanctions but strengthens institutional cooperation between the Electoral Justice and the parties, as emphasized by TSE President Minister Kassio Nunes Marques.

item.title: No G7, Lula defende regulamentação e critica valor de big techs
item.description: At the G7, President Lula advocated for social media regulation and criticized the disproportionate valuation of big techs, noting that 2.6 billion people remain offline while companies like Elon Musk’s SpaceX reach a $2.65 trillion market cap. He also praised Brazil’s Digital ECA as a global benchmark for protecting minors online and warned that AI could deepen inequalities without deliberate action.

item.title: Em áudio ‘vazado’, Lula diz que ‘não suporta comportamento’ de governo Trump
item.description: In a leaked audio from the G7 summit in France, Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva criticized the behavior of the U.S. government, saying he 'cannot stand' its approach, amid trade tensions and Washington’s designation of Brazilian criminal groups as terrorists. He also stated that Brazil 'does not like conflict' and that the world follows the 'middle way', reaffirming his background as a union leader rather than a leftist ideologue. Lula had sought a bilateral meeting with Trump to address differences, but the two did not greet each other during the official 'family photo'.

item.title: Mídia internacional noticia condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro pelo STF
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro was sentenced by Brazil's Supreme Court to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime for coercion in the judicial process, after pressuring the U.S. government to threaten Brazilian authorities and obstruct his father's trial. The ruling renders him ineligible for public office for 8 years and confirms the December 2025 cancellation of his congressional mandate. International outlets including The Guardian, Washington Post, Reuters, and Al Jazeera highlighted the conviction as another legal setback for the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Lula deve visitar MG ainda sem candidato a governador, e PT local cobra definição do presidente
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) is scheduled to visit Minas Gerais this week without yet having a defined gubernatorial candidate for the party in the state. The Minas Gerais PT directory expressed dissatisfaction with the lack of definition and has begun pressuring the president to make a decision on the state's major ticket. The visit occurs amid political maneuvering for the 2026 elections.

item.title: Big techs deverão comunicar retirada de conteúdo sem ordem judicial, aprova CDH
item.description: The Senate Human Rights Committee approved Bill 3.283/2025, requiring internet platforms to notify the removal of content without a judicial order within 24 hours to the CNJ, CNMP, OAB, and National Congress, aiming to increase transparency and prevent censorship following an STF ruling that limited provider liability. The mandate does not apply to automatic removals targeting spam, malware, fraud, or copyright violations.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que condenação de Eduardo Bolsonaro foi injusta
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas condemned the conviction of Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion in the course of legal proceedings as unjust. He defended the federal deputy’s acquittal, arguing the judicial decision was excessive. The statement was made in an interview released on June 17, 2026.

item.title: Brasil insiste em pressão contra tarifas após EUA não realizar reunião bilateral
item.description: The Brazilian government continues to pressure the U.S. to reverse the 37.5% tariffs on Brazilian products announced by Donald Trump, despite the lack of a bilateral meeting between Lula and Trump at the G7 summit in France. Lula is awaiting a phone call from Trump to explain Brazil’s position, which views the tariffs as a political tool rather than a commercial measure, aimed at strengthening Trump’s negotiating leverage.

item.title: Antes de julgamento no STF, Lula reforça defesa da regulação das big techs no G7
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva advocated at the G7 for regulating digital platforms to protect women, children, and adolescents from digital crimes, stating that regulating the digital environment is central to safeguarding fundamental rights. His remarks came on the same day the Supreme Federal Court (STF) resumed judgment on appeals by tech companies like Facebook and Google challenging the court’s expansion of platform liability for user-generated criminal content, even without a judicial order. The STF had previously set a 60-day deadline for big techs to implement 'duty of care' measures, including specific channels for content removal requests.

item.title: Sérgio Moro responde comparação de Gilmar Mendes do caso Master com Operação Lava Jato: ‘Ladainha’
item.description: Senator Sérgio Moro criticized Minister Gilmar Mendes' comparison between Operation Compliance Zero and Operation Lava Jato, calling it a 'ladainha'. He welcomed the STF's decision to maintain the preventive detention of Henrique and Felipe Vorcaro in the Banco Master case, calling it a victory for law and justice. Moro also praised the votes of André Mendonça, Luiz Fux, and Nunes Marques in favor of keeping the precautionary measures.

item.title: Caso Eduardo Bolsonaro: qual a fronteira entre a política e o direito?
item.description: Columnist Fernando Schüler analyzes the STF's ruling that convicted Eduardo Bolsonaro for coercion, questioning the legitimacy of lawmakers appealing to foreign institutions against Brazilian judicial decisions. He notes that while similar actions were taken by deputies in defense of Lula, there is now a trend to criminalize such conduct, which he views as dangerous for democracy. Schüler emphasizes that the real issue is not criticizing judicial decisions, but politically attacking institutions, which characterizes a non-republican regime.

item.title: Lula e Trump se cumprimentam no G7, mas reunião é descartada
item.description: Lula and Trump had informal encounters during the G7 summit in France, with no official bilateral meeting taking place. The interactions were brief and casual, including a corridor greeting and a social event hosted by Macron. Trade negotiations between Brazil and the U.S. continue at the ministerial level, without discussion of the recently announced U.S. tariffs.
